notes: Icy Veins (https://icy-veins.com/wow-classic/classic-leatherworking-profession-guide) returned HTTP 403 to automated fetches, so no Icy Veins comparison was made. Wowhead writes ranges with shared endpoints (1-30, 30-45, 45-55 ...); each step here starts one above the previous step's end. Wowhead marks the counts for Light Armor Kit (18), Dark Leather Boots 125-135 (12), Heavy Armor Kit (22), Nightscape Headband (11), Rugged Armor Kit (12) and Wicked Leather Gauntlets (32) as approximate (~). Wowhead offers no alternatives except at 290-300, where it names Wicked Leather Bracers, Pants or Gauntlets and says they need patterns and/or are not guaranteed skill-ups; their crafts are null because the guide gives no count. Created items, reagent counts and learnAt come from the recipe list on Wowhead's Leatherworking skill page; Light Leather and Light Armor Kit have no source listed there and are recorded as trainer/learnAt 1 (they come with Apprentice). Patterns: Wicked Leather Gauntlets = Pattern item 15725, vendor Leonard Porter (npc 12942, Alliance) / Werg Thickblade (npc 12943, Horde); Wicked Leather Headband = Pattern item 15744, drop from Jadefire Trickster (npc 7107); Wicked Leather Bracers = Pattern item 15728 (drop, e.g. Legashi Rogue); Wicked Leather Pants = Pattern item 15757 (drop). The Bracers/Pants pattern IDs were matched by name in the skill page's pattern list, not from a direct recipe link. Intermediates the guide says to save: Fine Leather Belts (85-100) and Cured Medium Hides (100-115) feed Dark Leather Belt; Cured Heavy Hides (155-160) feed Barbaric Shoulders and Guardian Gloves, and 20 are needed in total, so 15 more must be made (until grey at 170) or bought; Heavy Leather made at 150-155 is also used later. Rank-ups: Journeyman before 75 (level 10), Expert before 150 (level 20), Artisan before 225 (level 35), all from trainers. Wowhead's total shopping list: 90 Ruined Leather Scraps, 198 Light Leather, 10 Light Hide, 15 Medium Hide, 113 Medium Leather, 5 (40) Heavy Hide, 230 Heavy Leather, 435 Thick Leather, 436 Rugged Leather, 40 (135) Salt, 90 Coarse Thread, 116 Fine Thread, 37 Gray Dye, 122 Silken Thread, 42 Rune Thread, 42 Black Dye.
